messages:
ana: Thinking of running a 2-day "Appreciation Pop-up" next week — quick table in lobby with pre-written cards, $8 e-gift vouchers, and sticker bundles. Need: volunteer slots, PO for vouchers, remote fulfillment plan. who can help?

theo: I'm in for morning shift. Can we keep it low-footprint — no loose confetti per office rules?

priya: I can handle design + printing notes. Also happy to assemble care envelopes. Do we have a list of previous nominees to pre-print?

ben: I can pick up supplies and run procurement request for vouchers. Question: are vouchers taxable? need to flag payroll.

payroll-bot: Heads up: company policy — awards > $25 are reportable as income. See https://redwood.team/hr/awards-policy. E-gift vouchers under $25 typically don't require payroll reporting but check with payroll for aggregated reporting.

ana: (typo) ana: @payroll-bot good catch. Let's aim $8 vouchers to avoid reporting thresholds. Still need PO and vendor id.

office-bot: Office ops: no glitter/confetti on lobby carpet. We can support 1x 6ft table and 2 chairs. Storage: supplies can be left in closet A for event day.

theo: Proposed shifts (pick one):
```
Mon 11:45-13:15 (lunch)
Mon 15:00-17:00
Tue 09:30-11:00
Tue 12:00-13:30
```

priya: I'll take Mon 11:45-13:15 and Tue 12:00-13:30. will bring hand-stamped stickers.

ben: I'll take Mon 15:00-17:00. Will submit PO request today. What vendor do we use for e-gifts?

payroll-bot: Vendor recommendation: Giftly or Tango work — ensure invoices are tagged with AWDS-OPS cost center. For PO, include vendor tax ID and estimated qty.

ana: ana: For remote folks, can we offer mailing of a physical sticker pack + e-gift code? Theo — can you own the remote spreadsheet?

theo: Yep. I'll build a Google sheet with opt-in column and mailing addresses. Will ask remote folks to opt in by Thursday noon.

priya: Quick note on inclusivity: I'll make cards in EN/FR and put a QR code for translation requests.

ben: PO update: submitted (REQ-4521) — procurement asked for final voucher qty and unit price. I put 200x $8 on the request as a placeholder.

ana: ana: Thanks. Can we cap budget at $1600? leadership approved up to $1500 but we have leftover swag budget to cover small overage. Confirming now.

payroll-bot: Reminder: To hit the next payroll memo, awards need to be entered by Fri 17:00. Late entries will go to next cycle.

theo: Timeline for remote fulfillment? I can batch-send e-gift codes same day if I get the list by EOD Mon. Physical mail may need a Sat courier.

office-bot: Courier note: Sat pickups incur $25 fee. If enough remote packages, we can schedule standard Sat pickup. Confirm count by Wed.

priya: Task list quick:
- theo: remote spreadsheet + codes + Tue morning mail run if needed
- ben: procurement + PO follow-up + pick up stickers/envelopes
- priya: design + print + assemble note cards
- ana: event post in #all-hands + RSVP form + payroll follow-up

ben: I flagged procurement to use AWDS-OPS cost center. Also will order eco-cardstock.

ana: ana: I'll post the RSVP form in #all-hands with slots and remote opt-in. Also adding FAQ about tax implications and contact for payroll questions.

theo: Small UX ask: can we have pre-printed suggested messages on the cards for quick signing? speeds things up.

priya: Yes — printing template now. 4 messages per card + blank line.

payroll-bot: FYI for organizers: keep a record of recipient + voucher code mapping for audit. Payroll may request the list.

ben: Noted. I'll add a column in the spreadsheet for voucher codes and redemption status.

ana: ana: Great teamwork. I'll follow up tomorrow with a 1-pager runbook (setup, teardown, who brings what, emergency contact). Please drop any conflicts in the sheet. :star2:

priya: Putting myself down for 30m early setup both days.

theo: I'll do a quick test-send of e-gift codes once ben confirms vendor.

ana: ana: Locking this thread. Will pin the runbook when it's ready. Thanks all :heart:
